THE THINKING↙
01

Keep the screen in sight.

Portrait stacks the view and controls. Landscape splits the keyboard below the view; quick keys and the trackpad use a side deck.

02

Your languages. One tap away.

Pin English, ไทย, 中文, 日本語 — or build your own layout. Type on TopVNC keys, with native OS input available whenever you prefer.

03

Build muscle memory.

Arrange keys, control groups, and the thumb dock yourself. Save different portrait and landscape layouts. Nothing moves based on usage.

↳ A deliberate detail

A lit modifier means “next key.” It clears after use or when you leave the view.

Ctrl+C→released
